Teamwork, Pings and Role Quests

How to communicate without typing, how to keep a good attitude, and what your role quest gives you.

Pings: talk without typing

Typing in the middle of a fight gets you killed. Instead, use pings: quick signals on the map. Hold G (or Alt) and click, or use the ping wheel. The most useful ones:

  • Enemy Missing (?): an enemy left their lane. Always ping this when your opponent disappears.
  • Danger / Retreat: warn a teammate to back off.
  • On My Way: you're coming to help.
  • Assist Me: you want help.
  • Push / Hold, and pings on an objective like a dragon to suggest taking it.

You can also ping an enemy's summoner spell on the scoreboard to share when their Flash comes back.

Pro tipPing "On My Way" on dragon about 45 seconds before it spawns. It gives your team time to get ready and makes it clear what the plan is.

Good communication

  • Keep chat short and useful: "flash down mid", "drag in 1 min".
  • Praise good plays. A simple "nice" makes teammates play better.
  • Don't argue about who made a mistake mid-game. It can wait (forever).
Common mistakeSpamming pings on a teammate after they die. It never helps them play better, and it often makes the whole team play worse. If someone is doing this to you, mute them.

Muting and focusing on yourself

You can mute any player from the scoreboard (Tab) or by typing /mute followed by their name. Many good players mute all chat by default (/muteall) and only use pings. There's no shame in it.

The only player you control is you. In every game, focus on one or two things you want to do well, like your CS or your minimap checks. Win or lose, you can still improve. Read more in The Mental Game: Tilt, Focus & Improving.

Role quests

Every player automatically gets a role quest for their assigned position. You make progress by playing your role: killing minions, taking plates and objectives, getting takedowns, and spending time in your lane. When you complete it, you get a reward:

RoleQuest reward
TopA free Unleashed Teleport (or a big shield if you already took Teleport), bonus experience, and a level cap of 20.
JunglePrimal Smite, extra gold and XP from large camps, and bonus move speed in the jungle and river.
Mid+8% attack damage and ability power, and your Tier 2 boots upgrade to Tier 3 for free.
Bot+300 gold, extra gold per minion and takedown, and your boots move to the quest slot, freeing an item slot.
SupportFree upgrades to your support item, Control Wards for 40 gold, and up to 2 Control Wards stored in the quest slot.

Early on, playing outside your assigned lane costs you: you get 25% less minion gold and XP there until level 3 (supports until level 5). Stay in your lane early.

Play as a team

League is won by teams that move together. When your team pings an objective, go there. When four teammates are fighting, join them rather than farming alone. Five average players working together beat five great players who ignore each other.

Key takeaways

  • Use pings instead of typing, especially "Enemy Missing".
  • Keep chat short and positive; mute anyone who tilts you.
  • Focus on your own play: it's the only thing you control.
  • Every role gets an automatic quest with a reward; stay in your lane early to complete it.
  • Group with your team for objectives and fights.
